title: Kelly's lemma (induced form)
statement_en: Kelly's lemma, induced form: if G and H on n vertices are hypomorphic, then for every k < n and every graph F on k vertices, G and H have the same number of k-vertex subsets inducing a copy of F.
statement_lean: ∀ n : ℕ, ∀ G H : SimpleGraph (Fin n), Recon.Hypomorphic G H → ∀ k : ℕ, k < n → ∀ F : SimpleGraph (Fin k), {S : Finset (Fin n) | Nonempty (G.induce (S : Set (Fin n)) ≃g F)}.ncard = {S : Finset (Fin n) | Nonempty (H.induce (S : Set (Fin n)) ≃g F)}.ncard
author: reducer
